generation.scope: At rank ten a four-support forward center with a twisted cubic second curve reaches a center on that cubic whose successor line is the flat limit of the general pencil kernels and whose own second curve is a conic. The original third curve is a line or conic, a conic is followed by a line, and the second normal form forces a third line. Thus every four-support center reaches a ternary center within three edges, even in a terminal recurrent class.

open_mathematics: Analyze the ternary centers necessarily present in every terminal recurrent class at rank ten: separate regular and singular three-by-three pencils, their projected cubic configurations and pure-relation incidence. Continue the unequal triples in the finite reduced rank-ten chart.
